prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache beginning the day after the incident. Cervical range of motion was reduced in flexion and rotation, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild guarding on palpation. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with intact strength, sensation, and reflexes in the upper extremities. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings.

Care consisted of 12 visits over the course of treatment, including manual therapy to the cervical spine, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for deep neck flexor and scapular strengthening, and home exercise instruction with posture education. Symptoms improved steadily, with reduced neck pain, improved range of motion, and better tolerance for daily activities and driving. Headache frequency decreased over the treatment period.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported residual intermittent stiffness, particularly with prolonged computer use, but was functioning well overall. Discharge from active care was recommended with a continued home exercise program and return precautions for any new or worsening neurological symptoms.
